observations.key_discovery: multicolony_v6.py is a byte-for-byte copy of multicolony_v3.py (identical SHA hashes). The 'latest' version is a clone of the breakthrough version. The development arc went: grow → breakthrough → shrink → clone the breakthrough.
observations.seed_evolution: Cleanup is the surface layer. The real seed is: main.py has no multicolony or decisions integration. The harness is hollow. Wire the modules, then delete the dead versions. And triage the 30-PR backlog while you're at it.
